description: Rooms (protocol/06-rooms.md). `lobbies`: the names a world's default room fills one at a time, "lobby" then "lobby-2" and on, at most `lobbiesMost`, each with its topic for the world at `world` (the SHA-256 of "nswp/room/spike-1", the world's origin and path, and the name, on three lines). `noLobby`: numbers that name none. `full`: what a member of a full room sends someone joining it, before it is encrypted to them as any message to one member is. `relays`: where the kit's rooms meet when a world names none.
